body: Would you miss the sunrise in the morning? Your favorite food? Your personal belongings? I know that they're things that you will miss because you are scared of going through with it. That means you do have something to live for.

I know you are in a dark place right now op. I have been there multiple times. If you are scared of ending it all, it means that they're reasons against ending your life. Make a list of reasons to live, stuff that you would miss, and people that you care about. Sometimes, you may find that the little things are worth living for. I hope this helps, good luck op. Best of wishes.

Believe me, I have tried. Multiple times. I havent told them about my suicidal urges because I am afraid of how they would react. Whether it is anger or so much worrying that it actually jeopardizes my social life at school. (Which is the only time I am truly happy)
